domain_review.notes: Arithmetic is reproducible; scope and poker-language review remain independent gates.

claims.text: For an immediate call with no future betting modeled, the break-even equity threshold is call amount divided by the pot after the call.
limitations: The formula excludes future action, rake, range uncertainty, and equity realization.

claims.text: Facing a bet of b times the pot before the bet, the same simplified threshold is b divided by 1 plus 2b.
internal_evidence: call = bP; final pot after call = P + bP + bP; threshold = bP / (P + 2bP)
limitations: This is an algebraic identity under the stated immediate-call model, not a strategy recommendation.

claims.text: The simplified thresholds are 25% against a half-pot bet, approximately 28.6% against a two-thirds-pot bet, and approximately 33.3% against a pot-sized bet.
limitations: Percentages are call-price thresholds only; trustworthy equity still requires an explicit opponent range and future-card model.

rights.allowed_product_use: Display formulas, worked examples, and independently recomputed fixtures.
